explanations.1: This line matches (selects) files that end with .pl, .php, .cgi, or .spl — the dollar sign means 'end of filename' and the pipe | means 'or'.
explanations.2: This checks if Apache has the mod_headers module installed before trying to use Header commands, so the config won't break if that module isn't available.
explanations.4: This prevents your site from being embedded inside an iframe on another website, which is a security measure against clickjacking attacks.
explanations.5: This tells old browsers (Internet Explorer) to block suspected cross-site scripting attacks, though modern browsers ignore this header now.
